    level="1"
    right="Item 7"
    pfs="Restricted"
>
[Draconic Toxin Bottle](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2378)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Air" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=5" />
<trait label="Conjuration" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=33" />
<trait label="Consumable" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=36" />
<trait label="Cursed" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=274" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 191 <sup>1.1</sup>

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This glass bottle appears to be a [_dragon's breath potion_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=185) of a specific dragon type (usually red) but has been polluted, making it toxic to use.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> Interact;     **Effect** You drink from the bottle and must succeed at a DC 25 Fortitude saving throw or become [sickened 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=34) (sickened 2 on a critical failure) and immediately vomit the potion directly onto yourself, taking damage as though you had failed a save against a standard _dragon's breath potion_. If you succeed at your Fortitude save, you become sickened 1 but otherwise are able to unleash a breath weapon as normal for a _dragon's breath potion_ of the appropriate type.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
name: Draconic Toxin Bottle
